def chain_rule():
    # The input is WELL-FORMED: no loops, no typos, exactly one valid chain exists, and it visits every pair exactly once.
    # Worked example: (aaa, bbb, aaa, bbb, ccc, ddd, aaa, bbb, ccc, ddd, ddd)
    # Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is B.
    # Start at aaa: the pair (aaa, bbb) comes first; its second item is bbb, so the next pair in the chain is (bbb, ccc).
    # Its second item is ccc, but ccc never appears as a first item - so ccc is the dangling end of the chain.
    return "aaa, bbb, ccc, ddd, ddd"
